sources.note: Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): the hWBTC market is a Compound CErc20Delegator whose fallback delegatecalls `implementation`, held in the low 20 bytes of storage slot 19. Reading the slot rather than trusting events: it held 0x7100cbca885905f922a19006cf7fd5d0e1bbb26c at both the creation block 59641454 and the incident block 90761918, and a binary search of eth_getStorageAt over that whole range found no change; the only NewImplementation(address,address) log on the market is at the creation block itself; keccak(eth_getCode) on the delegator is identical at the two blocks; and 0x7100cbca... is the sole address the victim delegatecalls in the exploit trace. Deployment is the correct basis.
